verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents secured or scoped API keys, per-user filter restrictions, or any tenant-isolation mechanism. The only related items are generic API-key authentication headers and user-level personalization ranking, which are adjacent features and do not restrict search access. Multi-tenant scoped tokens are a fair axis for a hosted search API, so absence of evidence yields none rather than na.

support.subject: As a developer, scoped or tenant tokens restrict each end user's searches to their own documents without separate indexes per user
